newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia gives green light for Privredna overhaul.
newsitem.headline: Croatia gives green light for Privredna overhaul.

text.p: The Croatian government on Thursday gave a green light for the overhaul of the largest troubled bank, Privredna Banka Zagreb, state media reported.
Croatian radio said the operation was an "extremely important step, enabling the enforcement of further stabilisation measures and economic growth".
No officials were available for comment as the government meeting was still in progress.
The national news agency HINA ran a statement from the central bank, saying the government would clear Privredna's asset portfolio of old doubtful loans and recapitalise it.
The central bank was put in charge of drawing up plans on how best to revive Privredna which have now been approved.
It an attempt to reassure the bank's clients, it said the bank's rehabilitation would not put their savings or other deposits in any kind of jeopardy.
According to the radio, Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa put the cost of Privredna's rehabilitation at three billion kuna (some $540 million).
He described it as a "major investment in Croatia", which would result in some 20 percent of the banking sector getting back on its feet.
The move is also expected to make easier the restructuring of the indebted state-owned enterprises, serviced by Privredna and which owe it money, such as the oil company INA.
A large portion of the Croatian economy, which is put by some at up to 70 percent, depends on the banks' financing.

The government has completed the recapitalisation of three ailing banks that began last year with Slavonska Banka. It had clients among farming firms, of which some were based in Serb-held Eastern Slavonia region.
Another two banks -- Splitska and Rijecka -- nearly collapsed under the weight of uncollected debts from shibuilding industry.
Their overhaul this summer led to a decline in money market rates to under 10 percent from over 30 earlier in the year. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
